propositions: _paged_search loops infinitely when a Jira server ignores startAt offsets and repeats the same page, advancing the request offset locally but receiving the same non-empty batch repeatedly until a harness cap terminates it
get_parent_map wraps _paged_search in a broad except Exception handler that converts any pager-level abort into silent empty-map degradation, neutralizing loud signals from offset-stall conditions

fetcher.fetch_snapshot's three enrichment handlers (parent, comment, issuelink) each wrap whole-project DC readers in broad except Exception blocks that swallow pagination-stall errors at the boundary deciding between loud failure and degraded snapshot

A startAt-ignoring stub measured 26 calls advancing offsets [0,3,6,9,12,15,18,21,24,27...] while receiving page 1 every time, proving the server-side offset-blindness axis distinct from the pre-existing page-size defect (bug 9263)

DC's short-page-capping behavior (jira.search.views.default.max) means short pages are normal with more to give, so adopting fetcher's short-page return-early branch would silently truncate 250-issue reads to 20 items
